description: Frozen teaching datasets for Tutorial V; notebooks require no live downloads.

Germany.extraction: Germany only (geo=DE), from the archived Eurostat response

units.United States: Billions of chained 2017 USD, seasonally adjusted annual rate; BEA
units.Germany: Chain linked volumes (2020), million euro, seasonally and calendar adjusted; Eurostat

gdp.level_sample: 1996Q1-2025Q4 (120 quarters); first quarter is a growth base
gdp.sample_choice: Main analysis: 1996Q2-2019Q4, before the pandemic. The complete contiguous sample through 2025Q4 is used only for the final sensitivity comparison.
gdp.transform: 100 * first difference of natural log of quarterly real GDP; not annualised
gdp.vintage: Current-vintage revised values downloaded on preparation date, not a real-time vintage.
gdp.main_analysis_sample: 1996Q2-2019Q4 (95 growth quarters); candidate models share 87 estimation quarters, 1998Q2-2019Q4, with hold_back=8
gdp.forecast: One-step historical forecast of 2020Q1 from origin 2019Q4; the observed 2020Q1 value is held out of order selection and estimation.

market.source: Kenneth French Data Library, daily Fama/French research factors
market.units: Decimal daily simple returns. market_return = Mkt-RF + RF.
market.definition: Broad value-weighted US CRSP equity market, including distributions; not an index price series.
market.notebook_analysis_sample: 2021-01-04 to 2025-12-31; 1,255 trading sessions; one contiguous sample after 2020
market.notebook_transform: 100 * log(1 + market_return); observations ordered by trading session; no holiday filling
